name: Duodimensional Claw
body:
Discipline Psychometabolism; Level Psychic warrior 3

MANIFESTING

Display Material
Manifesting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range Personal
Target You
Duration 10 min./level
Power Points 5

DESCRIPTION

If you have a claw attack (either from an actual natural weapon or from an effect such as claws of the beast), you can use this power to improve that weapon. One of your claws becomes two-dimensional, making it razor-sharp. The weapon is now psionically keen, increasing its threat range from 20 to 19–20. This benefit does not stack with other effects that improve a weapon’s threat range.
